The Household expenses page now follows dark mode. I haven't viewed it in the app, so check it at night.

The page had a hard-coded white background and fixed greys for the text, the dividers and the category pills. I replaced those with the app's own theme colours, which switch between light and dark. I also removed the page's own font and background so it uses the app's, like the other notes.

The layout and your data are unchanged. The previous version of the page is kept if you want to go back.
